name: Ubtech Robotics Corp Ltd
summary: Ubtech Robotics Corp Ltd engages in the research, design, development, production, commercialization, marketing, and sale of robotic products and services in China, Hong Kong, and internationally. It offers humanoid robots; first full-stack unmanned logistics services; lifting mobile robots; latent towing robots; light- and heavy-load unmanned forklifts; heavy-load omnidirectional robots; stacker robots; and the Chitu L4-level unmanned logistics vehicle as well as commercial service and consumer grade robots.
